bundled_assets_only.description: All runtime assets must be served from the application bundle.

deterministic_entrypoint.description: The runtime entrypoint must be loaded from a deterministic package-relative path.

main_frame_provenance.description: Bridge messages and navigation must be restricted to the main document frame.

no_fallback_shell_substitution.description: The runtime must not substitute a fallback shell when the declared entrypoint is unavailable.

origin_provenance.description: Bridge messages must be restricted to the configured origin with exact host matching.

persistent_storage_partition.description: IndexedDB must persist across launches within a stable storage partition.

remote_network_prohibition.description: General network access must be prohibited. Only bundled assets may be loaded.

secure_context.description: The runtime must execute in a secure context.

stable_origin_across_launches.description: The document origin must be stable across app launches.

worker_availability.description: Web Workers must be available for the Pyodide runtime.
